summary.name: Klib
summary.one_liner: Klib is a macOS app for importing, organizing, searching and exporting highlights and notes from Kindle, Apple Books and WeRead.
use_cases: Collect Kindle highlights into one place on a Mac
Export reading notes to Evernote or Markdown
Search highlights by title, author, notes or date
Review book notes without opening the Kindle app
summary.what_it_does: Klib imports highlights and notes from Kindle, Apple Books and WeRead into a single library on macOS. You can edit book titles, authors and notes, and hide books you have finished reading. It offers instant search across titles, authors, notes and dates, and can export the whole database or selected books to Evernote or Markdown. A Quick Look view and keyboard shortcuts are included for reviewing notes.
notable: Imports from Kindle, Apple Books and WeRead and exports to Evernote or Markdown
Quick Look notes view and full keyboard control
Opens book pages on Amazon for more information
Listed on awesome-mac under Ebooks; available on the Mac App Store
caveats: Mac-only; no Windows or iOS version is mentioned on the page
Page does not state pricing; the awesome-mac listing describes it as freeware
